## How do I back up my books?

<a id="back-up"></a>

Back Up & Restore keeps safe copies of your company file, automatically on a schedule and whenever you ask.

**Where:** **Setup › Back Up & Restore** (`/backup`)

1. Open Back Up & Restore (File > Back Up Company…). → **Setup › Back Up & Restore** (`/backup`)
2. Under "Automatic backups", choose how often, how many to keep, and a Backup folder on a USB drive or another disk. Click "Save settings".
3. Click "Back up now" to make a copy today.

> Good to know: Keep backups on a different disk from the company file. A backup on the same disk does not survive that disk failing.
>
> Good to know: You can also copy the .ironbooks file itself while it is closed in Ironbooks.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I back up my books?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I restore a backup?

<a id="restore-backup"></a>

Pick a backup from the history, look inside it to be sure it is the one you want, then restore.

**Where:** **Setup › Back Up & Restore** (`/backup`)

1. Open Back Up & Restore and find the backup under "Backup history". → **Setup › Back Up & Restore** (`/backup`)
2. Click "Look inside & restore…" to see what the copy holds before you choose it.
3. Restore. Ironbooks first makes a safety copy of the books as they are now.
4. No company open (a new computer): on the start screen choose "Open or restore a company file…" and pick the backup file.

> Good to know: Restoring replaces the current books with the backup. Anything entered since that backup is not in it.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I restore a backup?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I move my books to another computer?

<a id="move-to-another-computer"></a>

Your books are one file. Install Ironbooks on the other computer and open the same file there.

**Where:** **Setup › Company File** (`/company-file`)

1. On the old computer, see where the file is: Company File > "Show in folder". Close the company (File > Close Company). → **Setup › Company File** (`/company-file`)
2. Copy the .ironbooks file to the new computer, by USB drive or your network.
3. Install Ironbooks there and choose "Open or restore a company file…". Sign in with the same user name and password.

> Good to know: Two people at once? Do not pass copies back and forth: put the file on a shared drive or use multi-user mode.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I move my books to another computer?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I add a user and limit what they can do?

<a id="users-and-roles"></a>

Users & Roles sets who can sign in to this company file and what each person may do. A role sets access per activity, such as Invoices or Receive Payments.

**Where:** **Setup › Users & Roles** (`/users`)

1. Open Users & Roles and click "Add user". Enter their name, login and a password, and give them one or more roles. → **Setup › Users & Roles** (`/users`)
2. Built-in roles cannot be changed: use "Clone role" to make your own version, then tick what it allows.
3. View Permissions compares what each role or user may do, side by side. → **Setup › View Permissions** (`/users/permissions`)

> Good to know: Users and their passwords are stored in the company file, so they go wherever the file goes.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I add a user and limit what they can do?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I protect my company file with a password?

<a id="protect-file"></a>

A protected company file is encrypted. Only its user names and passwords, or its recovery key, open it, on any computer.

**Where:** **Setup › Security (2FA)** (`/security`)

1. An Admin opens Security and clicks "Protect This Company File with Passwords". → **Setup › Security (2FA)** (`/security`)
2. Print or save the recovery key and keep it somewhere safe. It is the way back in if passwords are forgotten.
3. For a second step at sign-in, set up Two-Factor Authentication on the same screen with an authenticator app, and save the recovery codes.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I protect my company file with a password?", or ask Ask AI.*

## I forgot my password. How do I get back in?

<a id="forgot-password"></a>

On the sign-in screen choose "I forgot my password", or use the file’s recovery key. An Admin can also reset your password.

**Where:** **Sign in** (`/login`)

1. On the sign-in screen click "I forgot my password" and answer your challenge question, or click "Use the recovery key". → **Sign in** (`/login`)
2. Or ask an Admin: in Users & Roles they open your user and choose "Reset password". → **Setup › Users & Roles** (`/users`)
3. Lost the phone with your authenticator app? Type one of your recovery codes instead of the code.

> Good to know: To change a password you still know, open Change My Password.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "I forgot my password. How do I get back in?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do several people work in the same company file?

<a id="file-server"></a>

Put the company file on a shared drive and open it from any computer. While someone is in it, it is locked to them, the way QuickBooks single-user mode works, until they let others in.

**Where:** **Setup › Multi-user** (`/multi-user`)

1. Add a user name for each person. → **Setup › Users & Roles** (`/users`)
2. If someone else has the file open, Ironbooks tells you who and on which computer, and offers Ask to Come In.
3. They choose Let Them In (you both work at once, multi-user mode), Hand It Over (they close it and it opens for you) or Not Now.
4. To let people join without asking, the person in the file chooses File > Switch to Multi-user Mode. → **Setup › Multi-user** (`/multi-user`)
5. The first time a computer lets others in, Windows may ask whether Ironbooks can use the network: choose Allow on private networks.

> Good to know: Working from outside the office: host over your Tailscale tailnet with "Host on Tailscale" on the Multi-user screen, and give the other person the connection code.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do several people work in the same company file?", or ask Ask AI.*

## Can I try something without changing my real books?

<a id="try-it-on-a-copy"></a>

Yes. "Try it on a copy" opens Ironbooks on a throwaway copy of your whole company file (the sandbox). An orange SANDBOX bar shows on every page and anything you print is stamped SANDBOX.

**Where:** **Setup › Try it on a copy** (`/sandbox`)

1. Click "Try it on a copy". The copy opens straight away. → **Setup › Try it on a copy** (`/sandbox`)
2. Practice or test anything. Emails, bank feeds, scheduled reports and automatic backups are off in the sandbox, so nothing leaves the copy.
3. When you are done: discard the sandbox (the copy is deleted) or keep it as a training file with a name you choose. Nothing is ever copied back into your real books.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "Can I try something without changing my real books?", or ask Ask AI.*

## What leaves my computer, and how do I control it?

<a id="privacy-network"></a>

Your books stay on this computer. Privacy & Network lists every service that could send anything out; each one is off until you turn it on.

**Where:** **Setup › Privacy & Network** (`/privacy`)

1. Open Privacy & Network. → **Setup › Privacy & Network** (`/privacy`)
2. Choose the Network mode: Offline, Local network + tailnet (recommended), or Allow cloud services I choose.
3. Under "What could leave this computer", turn on only the services you want. "Recent network activity" shows what was allowed or blocked.

> Good to know: Update checks (app version and platform only) are the one connection on by default, and you can turn them off here.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "What leaves my computer, and how do I control it?", or ask Ask AI.*

## Where are the settings?

<a id="preferences"></a>

Preferences holds settings for the whole company; My Preferences holds your own, such as the menu style, the address your forms are sent from, and light or dark appearance.

**Where:** **Setup › Preferences** (`/settings`)

1. Company-wide settings: open Preferences, pick a category on the left, change what you need and save. → **Setup › Preferences** (`/settings`)
2. Just for you: open My Preferences. → **Setup › My Preferences** (`/my-preferences`)
3. AI models and automation have their own screen. → **Setup › AI & Automation** (`/ai-settings`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "Where are the settings?", or ask Ask AI.*
